Package neqsim.process.operations.continuous

Class BaselineComparator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.continuous.BaselineComparator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BaselineComparator extends Object implements Serializable
Compares current KPI values with a promoted baseline and raises step and criterion triggers.

Step triggers fire when the absolute change from the baseline first exceeds its threshold; criterion triggers fire when a value first satisfies a condition such as "< 0.785". Both fire on crossing, so a persistent state raises one trigger rather than one per cycle.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
